baslik: A Cracked Rail Shattered Under an Express Train

sahneler.metin: One cracked rail shattered under an express train.
The train derailed at Hatfield, and four people were killed.
The rail had been weakened by fatigue cracking.
Tiny cracks had grown along the rail's corner.
The problem was known, but the rail was not replaced.
Under the train, it broke into many pieces.
Afterwards, emergency speed limits spread across the network.

aciklama:
Hatfield derailed an express train when a rail shattered. The cause: gauge corner cracking from rolling contact fatigue, left unrepaired, until the rail broke into many pieces.
